section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Creative Behavior Mating Preferences Checklist (CB-MPC), an instrument designed to assess the sexual attractiveness of various creative behaviors in a potential mate. It was compiled from items in the 27-item Creative Activities and Interests Checklist and scientific items from the Creative Behavior Inventory. The responses are measured on a 5-point Likert scale, and the instrument is analyzed item-by-item.
